# Running Mom

> > Running Mom is a community platform connecting pregnant and postpartum women with fitness guidance, training programs, and peer support for maintaining an active running lifestyle through motherhood.

Running Mom provides comprehensive resources for women navigating fitness during pregnancy and after childbirth, founded by Jill and Tracey with NYC Marathon experience. The site combines expert training guides, community forums, product recommendations, and inspirational stories from mothers balancing running with parenthood.

## Key Topics

- Postpartum fitness
- Pregnancy exercise
- Running training
- Half marathon
- Jogging stroller
- Interval training
- Strength training
- Running community
- Boston Marathon
- Motherhood and running
- Race training
- Fitness recovery
- Maternity support
- Running motivation
- Work-life balance

## Pregnancy & Postpartum Fitness

- [Exercise and Pregnancy](https://www.running-mom.com/exercise-and-pregnancy.html): Guide to prenatal fitness including yoga, pilates, swimming, and belly dancing
- [Exercise After Pregnancy](https://www.running-mom.com/exercise-after-pregnancy.html): Guide to postpartum exercise recovery and return to running for moms
- [Free Home Workout: 12 Week Plan for Beginners](https://www.running-mom.com/free-home-workout.html): 12-week free home workout plan for beginner cardio and strength training

## Running Training Guides

- [Beginning Runner: Getting Started Running](https://www.running-mom.com/beginning-runner.html): Beginner guide for starting running with marathon and 10k goal-setting tips
- [Half Marathon Running: Endurance Running](https://www.running-mom.com/halfmarathonrunning.html): 8-week half marathon training guide with endurance running tips for beginners
- [Running Tips and Techniques](https://www.running-mom.com/runningtips.html): Running techniques by Wendy Phaff covering hill training, speed, and running form
- [Interval Training: Speed Work for the Runner, Better Fitness Results for Everyone](https://www.running-mom.com/interval-training.html): Guide to interval training and speed work for improved running fitness
- [Marathon Running Gear](https://www.running-mom.com/marathon-running-gear.html): Complete guide to marathon gear including iPod and CamelBak packing checklist

## Equipment & Gear

- [Baby Jogging Strollers](https://www.running-mom.com/baby-jogging-strollers.html): Buying guide comparing BOB Revolution, Chariot Cougar, and Jeep jogging strollers
- [Running Music: Running Songs and Alternatives to Running with Music](https://www.running-mom.com/runningmusic.html): Guide to running music with iPod and MP3 players plus solo running alternatives

## Community & Inspiration

- [Running Forums for Running Moms](https://www.running-mom.com/running-forums.html): Community forums for running moms discussing jogging strollers and pregnancy fitness
- [Running Articles](https://www.running-mom.com/running-articles.html): Articles on postpartum exercise, nutrition, strength training, and Gabriella maternity support
- [Inspiring Running Moms Ezine](https://www.running-mom.com/running-moms-ezine.html): Newsletter signup for Running Moms Ezine with running inspiration and community
- [Fit Moms](https://www.running-mom.com/fit-moms.html): Feature nominating inspiring mothers like Maria Ray in running community
- [Running Woman: Becky](https://www.running-mom.com/running-woman-becky.html): Interview with runner Becky from Alaska on training, injury recovery, and motivation

## Events & Races

- [Races: A Fun Family Event](https://www.running-mom.com/races.html): Family-friendly racing guide featuring Central Park and New York Road Runners events

## Core Pages

- [Running Mom, Share Your Passion with Your Newborn](https://www.running-mom.com/index.html): Homepage for Running Mom community connecting postpartum fitness with Boston Marathon training
- [About Us](https://www.running-mom.com/AboutUs.html): About Running-Mom.com founded by Jill and Tracey with NYC Marathon experience
